  1. ATME Accredited by NBA( National Board of Accreditation) in 2019 Youngest college to get NBA Accreditation among VTU affiliated colleges
  2. ATME has been ISO 9001-2015 Certified. ISO is a universal standard that can help any institution certified with the Quality Management System.
  3. ATME College of Engineering won the Brands Academy Education Excellence Award for Most Promising Upcoming Private Engineering College in Karnataka in the Year 2012 & 2013 from MHRD, New Delhi.
  4. ATME College is identified as Remote center from Indian Institute of Technology, Bombay to conduct seminars, FDP and Workshops in recent trends in technologies.
  5. ATME College is identified as Nodal center for Virtual Lab an initiative from MHRD, New Delhi, authorized to conduct workshop for students and staff.
  6. ATME College is having MOU with major industries to conduct student internships & research activities.
  7. ATME College having CISCO Center of Excellence for advanced Networking in association with CISCO India, which offers certification courses for students.
  8. ATME College having VLSI incubation with FrenusTech Pvt Limited, Bengaluru to train the engineering students & staff in the emerging areas of VLSI.
  9. ATME College conduct its annual cultural fest ATMEYA with social responsibility themes to contribute its best to the society.
  10. ATME College is offering the special scholarship scheme “Vidyaasare” for the meritorious students.
  11. ATME College has been identified as research center for pursuing Ph.D. in the emerging areas in EC,Mech,EE, CS, Physics & chemistry
  12. ATME College stands 19th overall in VTU team ranking in sports and cultural activities.
